rationale: Thin single office page of a global search network; little HU-specific recurring signal versus Amrop/Stanton Chase already covered.
Marketing page asserting HU search leadership; weak recurring output, useful only as a cross-check on contested rankings.
Standalone HU finance-media career/HR desk that mirrors recruiter salary guides — durable, often ungated early-intent channel.
Payroll-derived HU compensation benchmarks are a valuable independent labour-market check, but access/licensing depth is unclear.
Crowd-reviewed HU recruiting-firm directory: mine once for boutique/fintech-focused actors, low credibility as evidence.
Canonical member list of ~67 HU credit institutions incl. GIRO — cheapest one-off expansion of the banking entity universe.
Association presidency/supervisory board page gives dated, named senior-bank leadership moves on a triennial cycle.
Working-group directory names payments/IT/compliance owners across member banks — core A5 who-does-what mapping with rotation signals.
Fintech/payment-institution member list plus board with two-year mandates: actor set and recurring leadership events no bank list covers.
ICT association member directory and fintech working group — vendor-side counterpart with documented elnökség elections.
Annual board elections published with name/title/company; committee pages surface financial-services country managers.
Board and member-company directory with bank entries and a scheduled 2026 nomination cycle — trackable leadership events.

Insurer association with documented election cadence yields a clean dated leadership stream for bancassurance-adjacent actors.

Small DLT association about/board page; some overlap with HU payment startups but thin and infrequently updated.
Single trade-press interview standing in for a body with no portal — evidence and tracing anchor, not a monitorable source.
Leading HU financial daily; article URL should be generalised to its bank/tag chronologies as the corroboration layer for board changes.
HU fintech trade portal with deeper coverage of association appointments and new entrants than the association itself.
Ready-made chronological tag archive for MAFISZ leadership items; cheap timeline reconstruction, monitor as a feed.
Recurring English column aggregating all foreign chambers' leadership and committee news — one feed replaces crawling each chamber.
Chamber management page names board members from UK-linked banks and PSPs; turnover doubles as an executive-move signal.
AHK network hub page is only a pointer to the Hungarian chapter; the DUIHK national domain is the source worth registering.
Governance sub-page of mnb.hu (21 siblings) — valuable named/dated appointments inside the supervisory perimeter, covered by monitoring MNB.
Single programme communiqué mapping payments-fraud policy ownership; useful evidence, the NKI newsroom is the monitorable parent.
Publications/CV layer of bankszovetseg.hu already monitored via its member and governance pages; biographical backfill only.
Bank corporate newsroom is a repeatable, sometimes earlier corroboration channel for association-seat and executive moves.
